Game Overview

At its heart, Ultimate Fight is a action game about "Dive into Ultimate Fight, an electrifying two-player showdown where reflexes and strategy reign. Share a console for dynamic shootouts on beautifully crafted battlefields. Outsmart and outgun your adversary using quick reflexes and tactical maneuvers in this addictive and competitive experience crafted by celebrated Italian developers."
